title: Review-quality overhaul: structured findings + server-side verdict (item 1), verification ladder (item 2), method-angle procedures (item 3), deterministic risk router (item 4), shared-evidence prompt prefix (item 5) — 7 file-disjoint slices, all behavior-shifting pieces behind off->log->on, reviewer vocabulary mirroring Claude Code's /review skill
summary: Decompose the five prescribed changes into a 7-slice DAG that honors the issue's binding sequencing (prompt-only rules first, finding schema + server-side verdict next, risk router third, shared-evidence prefix last). Two file-disjoint roots (S1 prompts, S2 schema) run in parallel. v2 CORRECTS v1's false 'consensus_wrapper.py serial spine': the orchestrator-side slices are actually file-disjoint (S3 edits approval_matrix.py + routes/consensus.py + event_prompt/_render_nacks.py; S4 edits consensus_wrapper.py; S5 edits review_graph.py + agent_model_resolution.py + a new router), so slice ORDER is driven by the issue's binding sequencing + logical coupling to the finding schema, NOT by file contention — S4 and S5 are parallel-capable after S3. Every behavior-shifting piece rides off->log->on copied in shape from slice_green_gate.green_gate_mode() and fails safe to off. Reviewer prompt text, tiers, angles, verify ladder, finding shape, and gap sweep mirror Claude Code's built-in /review skill. Cost is a first-class success criterion: the router defaults low-risk slices aggressively to cheaper /review tiers, and item 5's cache-hit rate + per-wave cost in log mode gate the flip to on.
problem_statement: egg's review machinery has the right skeleton (asymmetric review graph, deterministic ACK/NACK verdict, specialist lenses, adversarial tester, Delphi redaction, conditional ACK) but four gaps cost real currency: (1) prose-only NACKs burn revision rounds on unreproducible objections; (2) criteria say WHAT to look for but not HOW to search, and say nothing about deletions; (3) every slice gets every lens at full depth regardless of risk, and every reviewer in a wave cold-starts re-reading the same diff. This issue closes all four with five changes; no eval/benchmark harness and no human-feedback loop are in scope (single-operator deployment; operator judges quality directly).

corrections_from_v1_review.R8_no_serial_spine: v1 claimed S3/S4/S5 all edit consensus_wrapper.py and form a serial spine. WRONG. Verified file-overlap map: S3 -> approval_matrix.py + routes/consensus.py + routes/event_prompt/_render_nacks.py; S4 -> consensus_wrapper.py (per-EVENT budget); S5 -> review_graph.py + agent_model_resolution.py + new router + config, reusing build_event_pump_wrapped_command(effort=) as a PARAMETER (no wrapper edit). => S4 and S5 are file-disjoint and parallel-capable after S3. Ordering is the issue's binding sequencing + schema coupling, not file contention.
corrections_from_v1_review.R1_effort_is_new_behavior: --effort is pinned ONLY for fable aliases today (agent_model_resolution.py:420 `effort=FABLE_EFFORT if model in _FABLE_ALIASES else None`; module comment :72 confirms every other model gets None). S5's tier->effort map is a NEW behavior change for claude/opus reviewers, NOT reuse — ship behind the router flag; keep effort=None on no-match to preserve today's byte-identical opus baseline.
corrections_from_v1_review.R2_recovery_callers_no_slice_ctx: get_review_graph_for_phase is called with NO slice context from startup_reconciliation.py:310, health_checks/tier1/incomplete_consensus_stall.py:251, kubernetes_monitor.py:933. S5 must PERSIST the resolved gated graph per-slice and have those callers READ it, or the stall-detector's expected-reviewer set diverges from what was spawned.
corrections_from_v1_review.R3_nack_render_path: The producer's open-NACK barrier renders via routes/event_prompt/_render_nacks.py (+ _compose.py), NOT consensus_wrapper.py. S3's findings->reason renderer must land in LOCKSTEP with the verdict move and keep the legacy prose barrier byte-identical in off/log, or the producer's NACK barrier goes blank.
corrections_from_v1_review.R5_per_event_not_per_finding_cap: A per-FINDING tool-call cap is not wrapper-enforceable (findings post-date the tool calls). Item 2's cap is reframed as a per-EVENT tool-call BUDGET in consensus_wrapper.py (S4).
corrections_from_v1_review.R4_cost_flip_gate_completeness: Item 5's cost-flip gate needs a concrete threshold + baseline, per-wave attribution, and must NET OUT the gatherer's own token cost. task_planner pins the threshold default.

reference_design.source: Claude Code built-in /review skill, extracted verbatim from the 2.1.201 binary, validated byte-identical against a live session. Full text: issue #3523 comments issuecomment-4898679999 (four effort bodies) + issuecomment-4898686738 (assembled example). BINDING operator directive: mirror this structure rather than invent a bespoke vocabulary.
reference_design.tier_ladder_to_item4: low (1 diff pass, no verify, hunk-only, no subagents, cap 4, test files skipped, forbidden from flagging outside the hunk — the docs-only minimal graph) / medium (3+5 angles x6, 1-vote verify, precision, cap 8) / high (same fan-out, recall-biased verify, cap 10) / xhigh=max (5+5 angles x8, recall, cap 15, plus a gap sweep).
reference_design.angles_to_item3: Correctness: A line-by-line diff scan, B removed-behavior auditor, C cross-file tracer, D language-pitfall (xhigh), E wrapper/proxy correctness (xhigh). Cleanup: reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude, conventions (quote-the-rule). Load-bearing rule: pass EVERY candidate with a nameable failure scenario through to verify.
reference_design.verify_to_item2: CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED with per-tier stance: medium=precision; high='PLAUSIBLE by default, REFUTED only when constructible from the code'; xhigh='a single non-REFUTED vote carries the finding'.
reference_design.finding_shape_to_item1: file, line, one-sentence summary, REQUIRED concrete failure_scenario. Cleanup findings reuse the shape with concrete cost in failure_scenario. Correctness outranks cleanup at the cap; ranked most-severe first; empty result explicit [].

architect_decisions_on_deferred_choices.slice_cut_points: Resolved in the 7-slice DAG; sequencing is fixed by the issue.
architect_decisions_on_deferred_choices.schema_field_encoding: JSON schema in shared/egg_contracts/ whose CORE mirrors the /review finding shape (file/line/summary/required failure_scenario) with egg extensions added ADDITIVELY: id, role, anchor (path+line_range OR slice-level), severity in {blocking,advisory}, confidence in {high,medium,low}, quoted evidence, optional suggested_patch, optional pre-merge obligation, and a schema_version field. Boundary-validated like attestation_schemas.py.
architect_decisions_on_deferred_choices.router_config_format: Per-repo YAML (recommended .egg/review-risk.yaml) mapping path-globs -> {lenses, tier}, resolved by most-specific-glob / deterministic first-match. No-match => full graph + loud warning + effort=None (opus baseline preserved).
architect_decisions_on_deferred_choices.evidence_gatherer_packaging: A NEW unprivileged role whose GitHub/verdict/post capabilities are STRUCTURALLY absent at the gateway role layer (shared/egg_restrictions/patterns.py) with NO review-graph edge, producing the evidence pack as a per-slice artifact consumed by the prompt-assembly layer in routes/event_prompt/.

binding_invariants: failure_scenario is REQUIRED to block; a blocking finding missing it degrades to advisory and NEVER errors.
The edge verdict is a PURE, unit-tested function of findings: any blocking => NACK; advisory-only => conditional-ACK (existing obligation_* path); empty => ACK.

The legacy prose-NACK path and its rendered barrier (event_prompt/_render_nacks.py) stay byte-identical while item 1's flag is off/log; the findings->reason renderer lands in lockstep with the verdict move.

Every behavior-shifting piece (S3 verdict, S4 per-event budget, S5 router, S6 prefix) rides off->log->on copied in shape from green_gate_mode(); unknown value fails safe to 'off'; 'log' records would-have-been behavior.
S5 tier->effort is NEW behavior: it ships behind the router flag and keeps effort=None on no-match, preserving today's byte-identical opus baseline (effort is pinned only for fable aliases today).

S5 persists the resolved gated graph per-slice; recovery/health callers of get_review_graph_for_phase (no slice context) READ it so the stall-detector's expected-reviewer set matches what was spawned.

Router no-match => FULL graph + loud warning; the security lens is structurally UN-gatable on auth/session/input-boundary paths; a floor tier guarantees a misrouted risky slice still gets a real review; cost-cutting never overrides these floors.
Item 2's tool-call bound is a per-EVENT budget (not per-finding); enforced in consensus_wrapper.py; flag-gated.
Evidence pack: EVIDENCE, NEVER CONCLUSIONS — mechanically path-ordered, byte-identical across a wave; reconciled against per-agent event_prompt composition + Delphi redaction.

The tester and any finding-VERIFIER stay COLD-START; Delphi redaction is UNCHANGED (pack carries repo facts, never the producer's self-assessment); the gatherer's unprivileged posture is structural at the gateway role layer with no review-graph edge.
Item 5 flips to 'on' ONLY after a MEASURED net cost reduction in 'log' mode with a pinned threshold + baseline, per-wave attribution, and the gatherer's own cost netted out.
Reviewer prompts (items 2-4) mirror the Claude Code /review vocabulary: tier ladder, finder angles, 3-state verify, finding schema, xhigh gap sweep.
Cost is a FIRST-CLASS success criterion: the router defaults low-risk slices to cheaper /review tiers; per-wave token cost is measured and reported for items 4 and 5 in log mode.
open_questions_note: None registered. The issue is a complete, prescriptive operator directive; the four previously-deferred choices are resolved above as architect decisions, not operator HITL. The only scope fork the issue itself names (item 5's shared-prefix fork point proving too shallow) is contingent on plan/implement-phase findings and raised at that point, not pre-emptively. NOTE: the plan-phase consensus timeout (decision-3) is an INFRASTRUCTURE deadlock (the simplifier's gateway session_phase stale-pinned at 'refine', per the overseer's stuck-phase-transition alert), NOT a plan defect — it is operator-owned and does not change this design.

risk_assessment.risk: Effort tiers are NEW behavior, not reuse: today --effort is pinned only for fable aliases, so a tier->effort map silently changes the opus baseline.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Ship behind the router flag; keep effort=None on no-match; log-mode records would-have-been effort; regression test asserts no-match leaves effort=None.

risk_assessment.risk: Gated graph divergence: recovery/health callers of get_review_graph_for_phase have no slice context and would compute a different expected-reviewer set than was spawned.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Persist the resolved gated graph per-slice; recovery/health callers read it.

risk_assessment.risk: NACK barrier goes blank: moving the verdict server-side without landing the findings->reason renderer (event_prompt/_render_nacks.py) in lockstep empties the producer's open-NACK barrier.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Land the renderer in the same slice; keep the legacy prose barrier byte-identical in off/log.

risk_assessment.risk: Cost-flip gate is unfalsifiable without a threshold/baseline/attribution and would count the gatherer's own cost as free.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Pin a concrete threshold + baseline; attribute per-wave; net out the gatherer's own token cost before flipping to on.

risk_assessment.risk: Per-finding tool-call cap is not wrapper-enforceable (findings post-date the calls).
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reframe as a per-EVENT tool-call budget in consensus_wrapper.py.

risk_assessment.risk: Determinism-boundary regression (item 1): server-side verdict changes today's ACK/NACK outcomes.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Verdict is a pure, unit-tested function of findings; log mode diffs computed-vs-legacy verdict without acting; legacy path stays until on.

risk_assessment.risk: Anchoring via the shared pack (item 5): an editorializing gatherer collapses convergence-as-signal.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hard evidence-never-conclusions rule; mechanical path ordering; cold-start tester/verifier; unchanged Delphi redaction; item 1's convergence metric makes anchoring regressions visible.

risk_assessment.risk: Prompt-cache fragility + untrusted-input concentration (item 5): any non-identical prefix byte voids the cache win; one gatherer funnels adversarial diff text to all lenses.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Assemble the prefix deterministically; reconcile byte-identity vs per-agent composition + Delphi; measure real hit-rate in log mode before on; pack is data-not-instructions per the existing untrusted-input posture.

acceptance_criteria_direction: Versioned finding schema in shared/egg_contracts/, boundary-validated; failure_scenario required for a blocking finding; verdict computed deterministically server-side (blocking=>NACK, advisory-only=>conditional-ACK, empty=>ACK); mechanism dedup attaches >=2 producers; findings->reason renderer lands in lockstep and keeps the legacy barrier byte-identical in off/log.

Shared criteria carry CONFIRMED/PLAUSIBLE/REFUTED, 'blocking must reproduce', 'drop only refuted / downgrade unconfirmed', the amplified-pre-existing-defect nuance, and a scratch-check permission; a per-EVENT tool-call budget is enforced in the wrapper.
code-review-criteria.md names the four method-angle procedures, including the deletion (removed-behavior) audit.

Deterministic risk router + per-repo config gates lenses and sets effort tiers via the existing --effort param; no-match => full graph + warning + effort=None; gated graph persisted per-slice and read by recovery/health callers; floor tier guaranteed; log-first.

Read-only evidence gatherer (structural gateway-layer capability denial, no review-graph edge) + byte-identical, mechanically-ordered shared prefix; tester and finding-verifier stay cold-start; Delphi redaction unchanged; flag-gated; log mode records cache-hit rate + per-wave cost; a measured net cost reduction (threshold/baseline/attribution pinned, gatherer cost netted out) gates the flip to on.
Every behavior-shifting piece rides off->log->on and fails safe to off.
Cost is a first-class success criterion: router defaults low-risk slices to lower /review tiers; per-wave token cost measured and reported for items 4 and 5 in log mode.
Reviewer prompts (items 2-4) mirror the Claude Code /review skill vocabulary (tier ladder, finder angles, 3-state verify, finding schema, xhigh gap sweep).
